verdict.rationale: The only build-against artifact in evidence is Adyen's official OpenAPI definitions repo on GitHub, usable with Swagger tooling to generate clients. The pack never mentions official language SDKs or client libraries for the agentic APIs (ACP/UCP tokenization, Agentic Cart, Feed). Probes of OpenAPI paths on docs.adyen.com returned 404. Missing for 10: documented official language SDKs/client libraries, SDK coverage of the Agentic Commerce APIs (cart, feed, ACP/UCP), install/usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
